experiments.what: Repaired shared validator DTI (FN_w summed over background, centre pixel excluded from TP window), replaced the single-scalar bootstrap with a segment-level cluster bootstrap, fixed the leakage canary (positives and negatives), removed invented Gaussian zones from the generator, and made the generator refuse to write without the official template and features. Later in the session: segments use 8-connectivity (4-connected fragments could leak across the split); the visible-fault buffer is a Euclidean disk of radius 3 px; the GeoTIFF writer no longer requests tiles (16-multiple error on 40-column grids) and deletes any partial output on failure.
experiments.evidence: tests/test_dti_and_generator.py (hand-computed DTI 0.370370 for the single-neighbour toy case; perfect prediction 1.0; FN_w counts GT pixels only; generator refuses with exit code 2) and tests/test_holdout_pipeline.py (canary flags a label copy at AUC > 0.99 and does not flag noise). All 11 tests pass, including a generator round trip on a 40-column grid (tiling bug fixed).
